description: This file defines schemas for plugin approval requests and resolutions using the TypeBox library, including validation constraints and external references for plugin approval configuration.

methods.name: Type.Object
methods.description: Creates a schema object with specified properties and options.

methods.name: Type.Optional
methods.description: Marks a schema property as optional.

methods.name: Type.String
methods.description: Defines a string schema with optional constraints such as minLength, maxLength, or enum.

methods.name: Type.Integer
methods.description: Defines an integer schema with optional minimum and maximum constraints.

methods.name: Type.Union
methods.description: Defines a union schema combining multiple types.
